result.summary: Ran the full mix test suite twice (once as the complete suite, once as an isolated test/letflow/plugs/ directory run) directly against the already-running letflow-postgres-1 container (docker ps confirmed healthy, port 5462) using the local toolchain (Erlang/OTP 29, Mix 1.20.3) -- no Docker fallback needed. Full suite: mix test --seed 0 -> exit code 0, 'Result: 132 passed (4 properties, 128 tests)', 0 failures/excluded/skipped/doctests. Output saved to scratch/req021_full_test_run.log (1316 lines) and grepped for failure/assertion/error markers -- zero matches, no 'Failures:' section. Isolated test/letflow/plugs/ directory: mix test test/letflow/plugs/ --seed 0 -> exit code 0, 'Result: 22 passed', zero failure markers in the saved log (scratch/req021_plugs_isolated_run.log). Additionally ran each of the 3 new files individually to confirm the per-file breakdown TEST-DESIGNER and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR both reported: auth_pipeline_test.exs 10 passed, auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs 3 passed, tenant_status_test.exs 9 passed (10+3+9=22, matching the isolated-directory total and the full-suite delta of 132-110=22). No hidden cross-test ordering dependency found -- identical pass counts whether run as part of the full suite, as the isolated plugs/ directory, or as individual files. Zero regressions against the 110-test pre-REQ-021 baseline (REQ-020's own full-suite total) and zero regressions against TEST-DESIGNER's own informal 132/132 (4 properties, 128 tests) sanity check from Step 3 -- this run independently reproduces that exact number on the current HEAD commit (13fec92, one commit later than TEST-DESIGNER's own run) with output captured to a log and programmatically grepped rather than eyeballed, which is what makes this the real Step 4 verification rather than a restatement of Step 3's claim. Known pre-existing noise (placeholder Keycloak issuer connection-refused retries from REQ-016's OIDC worker, ExUnit.Case.register_test/4 deprecation warnings on the 3 property tests) present and unchanged from prior WF-02 runs (REQ-018/019/020), does not affect any test outcome. Wrote test/reports/report-2026-08-16-WF02-REQ021-20260816.yaml with full detail: environment, both full-suite and isolated-run verbatim summary lines, per-file breakdown, per-acceptance-criterion coverage cross-reference, and the regression check against TEST-DESIGNER's baseline.
